layout.coordinate_transform: Layout 148 connected groups; center bounding box and divide by half of maximum range. C43 retained at (0,0) in separate inset (independent coordinate system). No node removal.
layout.interpretation: Coordinates are display positions, not measured distance, hierarchy, or causal influence.

encoding.node_area_pt2: 14 + 650 * sqrt(V_c / max(V)); V_c is observed fill USDC of member events
encoding.node_color: Display family of the single highest-amount existing taxonomy category; not a pure-community label.

profile_selection: C4: largest member-event fill amount; C3 and C2: largest and second-largest event counts.
node_label_selection: Eight largest groups by member-event fill amount plus separate-component C43. Labels do not filter nodes.
